signature.name: VTask.Realize
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {M : Type w} -> [L.Structure M] -> {α : Type u'} -> {l : ℕ} -> (_f : L.BoundedFormula α l) -> (_v : α → M) -> (_xs : Fin l → M) -> Prop

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.Realize is a structurally recursive total function on BoundedFormula constructors; every constructor is handled explicitly and no junk-value or out-of-domain conventions are required.

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type*) [L.Structure M] (α β : Type*) (m n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (g : α → β ⊕ Fin m) (v : β → M) (xs : Fin (m + n) → M), VTask.Realize (φ.relabel g) v xs ↔ VTask.Realize φ (Sum.elim v (xs ∘ Fin.castAdd n) ∘ g) (xs ∘ Fin.natAdd m)

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type*) [L.Structure M] (α : Type*) (n : ℕ) (φ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (v : α ⊕ Fin n → M), φ.toFormula.Realize v ↔ VTask.Realize φ (v ∘ Sum.inl) (v ∘ Sum.inr)
